source_note: Collaboration video (The Motley Fool and Couch Investor), hosted on The Motley Fool's channel. Detailed summary generated from video captions.
summary: Neil and a Motley Fool host each name two 'great buys to hold for the long term' against a backdrop of Mag-7 concentration (34% of the S&P 500). Neil's picks: Alphabet (GOOGL) — search fears overdone (+16.7% YoY), Google Cloud accelerating toward a $514B backlog, Gemini at 1B monthly users, 'one of the best tech companies out there' and a safe AI bet (restated BUY, no flip); and Amazon (AMZN) — his first tracked AMZN call, a BUY: 'shouldn't be left out of anyone's portfolio', AWS +36.7% YoY (~$170B run rate, fastest in 4+ years), Graviton/Trainium custom silicon each >$25B run rate, first company projected to $1T revenue in FY28. The host's picks: Shopify (SHOP) — Q2 revenue +34% to $3.6B, GMV +32%, agentic-commerce tailwinds; Neil praises its 'world class management' but makes no explicit call. Airbnb (ABNB) — $3.6B Q2 revenue (+17%), $27B gross bookings, $1B+ quarterly FCF, 'everything app' pivot; Neil is more skeptical, citing slow AI adoption and no loyalty program. No stance flips for Couch Investor.
title: 4 Stocks to Buy and Hold for the Long Term!

calls.thesis: First AMZN call on record: "shouldn't be left out of anyone's portfolio". AWS grew 36.7% YoY (~$170B annualized run rate, fastest in 4+ years); Graviton/Trainium custom silicon each >$25B run rate; first company projected to $1T revenue (FY28); core business very profitable with FCF to recover quickly after the capex cycle.
calls.base_case: TAM keeps expanding (AWS, ads, subscriptions, logistics-as-a-service); FCF recovers as investment pace slows.
calls.bull_case: AWS acceleration + AI custom silicon compound; wins whichever chatbot wins.
calls.bear_case: ~$200B capex this year depresses FCF near-term; "might not be the next 5x or 10x from here".
